title: 第二份遗嘱
music: suspenseful corporate power drama underscore, low strings, deep percussion hits, sparse piano, cold synth pad, instrumental, no vocals
logline: Manager Wang kneels in the rain, Zhao Zihang learns his family's deal is in Chen Mo's hands and Lin Wei is left behind; the next morning Chen Mo's uncle walks into the chairman's office with a later will that hands him the group.

clips.summary: {wangjl} runs out into the rain begging forgiveness; {chenmo} tells {suqing} to replace the manager and {wangjl} drops to his knees.
clips.soundscape: Heavy rain hammering on the canopy and the street, splashing footsteps, the sedan's engine idling.

cuts.speaker: wangjl
cuts.say: 陈……陈董！我有眼不识泰山！
cuts.act: 冲进雨里，结巴，又怕又急，声音发抖
cuts.delivery: panicked, rain plastering his hair, eyes wide
cuts.composition: Close-up of {wangjl} bursting out into the rain without an umbrella, the lit glass door behind him.
cuts.action: {wangjl} rushes forward through the rain, hands raised, hair plastered to his forehead.
cuts.camera: Handheld, backing away in front of him.

cuts.composition: Wide shot of {loc} in the downpour: {chenmo} and {suqing} under her black umbrella beside the black sedan at the foot of the steps on the right, {wangjl} stumbling down the steps toward them on the left.
cuts.action: {wangjl} slips down the last steps; {chenmo} does not turn.
cuts.camera: Static wide, rain streaking through the light.

cuts.composition: Medium two-shot of {chenmo} and {suqing} under the umbrella.
cuts.action: {chenmo} ignores the manager and turns to {suqing}.

cuts.speaker: chenmo
cuts.act: 淡淡的，像随口一说，没有一点火气
cuts.delivery: flat and quiet, not even looking at the manager
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {suqing}'s short black bob onto {chenmo} under the umbrella.
cuts.action: {chenmo} speaks quietly, his eyes on {suqing}.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {wangjl} in the rain.
cuts.action: {wangjl}'s face crumples; his knees start to buckle.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {wangjl} at the foot of the steps.
cuts.action: {wangjl} drops to his knees in the puddle, rain pouring over him.

clips.summary: {zihang} and {linwei} come out; {zihang} recognises {suqing}, who tells him his father's deal with the Chen Group will be reviewed by {chenmo} himself.
clips.soundscape: Heavy rain, the glass door swinging, footsteps on wet granite.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of the glass door at the top of the steps.
cuts.action: {zihang} and {linwei} hurry out under the canopy; {zihang} stops dead, staring down at the sedan.
cuts.camera: Static, then a slight push in as he stops.

cuts.speaker: zihang
cuts.act: 脸色大变，声音一下子虚了，说不下去
cuts.delivery: colour draining from his face, the words dying
cuts.composition: Close-up of {zihang} under the canopy, warm light from the door behind him.
cuts.action: {zihang}'s smug expression collapses.

cuts.speaker: suqing
cuts.line: 赵少，令尊下周和陈氏集团的合作，陈董会亲自审核。
cuts.say: 赵少，令尊下周和陈氏集团的合作……陈董会亲自审核。
cuts.act: 礼貌但冰冷，语速平稳，最后四个字加重
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {zihang}'s slicked-back head onto {suqing} under the black umbrella below.
cuts.action: {suqing} looks up at him evenly.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {zihang}.
cuts.action: {zihang}'s forced smile freezes on his face.

clips.summary: {linwei} steps forward trembling to explain; {chenmo} cuts her off and gets into the car with {suqing}.
clips.soundscape: Heavy rain, a car door closing, the sedan pulling away through the puddles.

cuts.speaker: linwei
cuts.act: 往前一步，声音发颤，想解释又说不出口
cuts.delivery: stepping forward, voice shaking, eyes wet
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {linwei} at the edge of the canopy, rain falling just in front of her.
cuts.action: {linwei} takes a step forward into the rain.

cuts.speaker: chenmo
cuts.act: 平静，不看她太久，语气很淡
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {linwei}'s wet hair onto {chenmo} under the umbrella by the car.
cuts.action: {chenmo} looks at her briefly, then away.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {linwei}, rain on her face.
cuts.action: {linwei}'s eyes fill; her lips part but nothing comes.

cuts.composition: Medium shot beside the black sedan.
cuts.action: {chenmo} turns and gets into the back of the sedan while {suqing} holds the umbrella over the door.

cuts.composition: Wide shot of {loc}: {linwei} alone on the wet steps in her white dress as the black sedan pulls away.
cuts.action: The sedan's tail lights recede into the rain; {linwei} stands motionless.

clips.summary: Next morning in {loc}, {chenmo} in a dark suit stands at the window; {suqing} reports the Zhao proposal and he sends it back.
clips.soundscape: Quiet office hum high above the city, faint traffic far below, footsteps on stone.

cuts.composition: Wide shot of {loc}: {chenmo} in a dark suit standing at the floor-to-ceiling window on the right, the city behind the glass, {suqing} crossing the stone floor from the left with a black folder.
cuts.action: {suqing} walks toward him; he does not turn from the window.
cuts.camera: Slow dolly in across the room.

cuts.speaker: suqing
cuts.line: 赵家的合作方案，已经放在您桌上。
cuts.say: 赵家的合作方案，已经放在您桌上了。
cuts.delivery: businesslike, folder held to her chest
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {suqing}, the sunlit window soft behind her.
cuts.action: {suqing} holds the folder to her chest.

cuts.speaker: chenmo
cuts.delivery: without hesitation, turning from the window
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {suqing}'s short bob onto {chenmo} by the window, sunlight raking across his face.
cuts.action: {chenmo} turns from the window.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of the walnut desk in the sun: a man's hand pushing a black folder back across the desk.
cuts.action: The folder slides away across the desk.

clips.summary: {guodong} walks in beaming with two lawyers and greets {chenmo} like a loving uncle.
clips.soundscape: The heavy door swings open, footsteps on stone, a briefcase clicks.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of the tall wooden door, two lawyers in grey suits with briefcases a step behind {guodong}, out of focus.
cuts.action: {guodong} pushes the door open and strides in, arms spread, beaming.
cuts.camera: Handheld, backing away in front of him.

cuts.speaker: guodong
cuts.line: 小默啊，这么多年在外面受苦了，二叔心疼。
cuts.say: 小默啊……这么多年在外面受苦了，二叔心疼。
cuts.act: 满脸堆笑，语气亲热，拖着长辈腔，笑里带着打量
cuts.delivery: a broad warm smile that does not reach his eyes
cuts.composition: Held chest-up medium close-up of {guodong} composed off-centre, the sunlit office soft behind him.
cuts.action: {guodong} smiles broadly, eyes narrowing as he sizes his nephew up.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {chenmo}, sunlight raking across his face.
cuts.action: {chenmo}'s face stays unreadable.

cuts.speaker: chenmo
cuts.act: 平平地叫一声，不冷不热
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {guodong}'s grey temple onto {chenmo}.
cuts.action: {chenmo} nods once.

clips.summary: {guodong} questions whether a delivery rider can run the group and puts a will on the desk.

cuts.speaker: guodong
cuts.line: 不过集团这么大，你一个送外卖的，管得过来吗？
cuts.say: 不过集团这么大……你一个送外卖的，管得过来吗？
cuts.act: 笑着，话锋一转，语气轻飘飘的，带着嘲弄
cuts.delivery: still smiling, the warmth turning to mockery
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {guodong}, smiling.
cuts.action: {guodong} tilts his head, his smile thinning.

cuts.composition: Medium shot across the walnut desk: {guodong} on the left, {chenmo} on the right behind the desk.
cuts.action: {guodong} lays a stapled document on the desk and slides it toward {chenmo}.
cuts.camera: Slow push in toward the desk.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of the stapled document with the red seal on the sunlit walnut desk, fingertips resting on it.
cuts.action: Two fingers tap the red seal once.
cuts.camera: Slow tilt down to the seal.

cuts.speaker: guodong
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {guodong} leaning over the desk.
cuts.action: {guodong} straightens up and folds his hands.

clips.summary: {suqing} sees the will is dated one day later than theirs; {guodong} declares the group is his.
clips.soundscape: Quiet office; a page turns; a long silence.

cuts.speaker: suqing
cuts.line: 这份遗嘱的日期，比我们手里的晚了一天。
cuts.say: 这……这份遗嘱的日期，比我们手里的，晚了一天。
cuts.act: 一向冷静的人第一次乱了，开头卡了一下，压着惊讶
cuts.delivery: her composure cracking, eyes darting over the page
cuts.composition: Close-up of {suqing} looking down at the document, sunlight on her glasses.
cuts.action: {suqing}'s eyes stop on the page; her face changes.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {chenmo}.
cuts.action: {chenmo}'s eyes go still.

cuts.speaker: guodong
cuts.line: 老爷子临终前改了主意。
cuts.say: 老爷子临终前……改了主意。
cuts.composition: Medium close-up from mid-chest up of {guodong}, the window light behind him.
cuts.action: {guodong} chuckles softly.

cuts.speaker: guodong
cuts.line: 从今天起，陈氏集团，归我。
cuts.say: 从今天起，陈氏集团……归我。
cuts.act: 笑容收起，一字一顿，压低声音，带着威胁
cuts.delivery: the smile gone, leaning in, menacing
cuts.composition: Over-the-shoulder shot past {chenmo}'s dark suit shoulder onto {guodong} leaning over the desk.
cuts.action: {guodong} leans in over the desk, his smile vanishing.

clips.summary: {chenmo} looks at the will, then slowly raises his head.
clips.soundscape: Silence, a clock ticking faintly, the city hum far below.

cuts.composition: Extreme close-up of the will with the red seal on the sunlit desk, a man's fingertips resting at its edge.
cuts.action: The fingertips press slowly down on the page.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {chenmo} looking down at the desk, sunlight raking across half his face.
cuts.action: {chenmo} slowly raises his head and looks straight at his uncle, eyes cold and steady.
cuts.camera: Very slow push in as his eyes come up.
